The '''X-Alpha heavy cargo sled''' was a [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. One such vehicle was used to transport a [[Unidentified Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]] before and after it was [[Zillo Beast incident/Legends|killed]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
